| REVIEW_RATES | TIMESHEET / actual current Timesheet UUID | **Review rates**. Enabled for current unresolved native rate authority; actual existing rate-edit/pay action permission. If no Timesheet exists, emit OPEN_SOURCE_REVIEW instead. |
